issues.detail: The Greek 'εν πνευμα εστιν' means 'is one spirit' (one in spirit), not 'becomes one Holy Spirit' (trở nên một Thánh Linh). The Vietnamese adds 'Thánh' (Holy) and changes 'is' to 'becomes', altering the meaning from a state of unity with the Lord to a transformation into the Holy Spirit.
